therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA damage repair pathway disruption in BRCA-deficient tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Confirmed Objective Response Rate (ORR) according to RECIST criteria

subgroup_findings: Higher response rate with 400mg dose vs 100mg dose (42.3% vs 25.0%)
Better PFS with 400mg dose (193.5 days vs 122 days)
Higher clinical benefit rate with 400mg dose (84.6% vs 70.8%)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events including cerebral hemorrhage, convulsion, acute renal failure
results.dose_information: Two dose levels tested: 100mg and 400mg orally, administered as capsules

context.duration: Approximately up to 2 years treatment and follow-up
